text:
ashley: opened a docs PR for Dedicated deployment guide. need one quick reviewer and aim to merge after the 3pm freeze lifts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 :wave:
devon: I can do voice/style. quick note: avoid marketing adjectives like "best-in-class" and prefer declarative, neutral phrasing.
linus: CI preview failed on the PR. ci-bot reported a missing anchor in /sdk/python/migration.
ci-bot: preview build failed for PR #4901 1: error: anchor "kv-cache-note" not found in /sdk/python/migration. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3578
sam: i'll patch the anchor and update the Python snippet to the unified client. current snippet uses old client.generate(). putting a draft in.
sam: draft snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.text.generate(model="redwood-alpha-1", input="Summarize...", max_tokens=80)
print(resp.output_text)
```
mica: terminology nit: use "model variant" for runtime fallbacks and "model version" for pinned artifacts. also prefer "cache key" instead of "KV key" in public docs.
devon: tone nit: replace any "you can easily" phrasing with objective guidance like "to reduce latency,". avoid second-person imperative in config examples.
docs-bot: lint: headings must be sentence case (docs/dedicated/deploy.md line 40). prefer fenced code blocks for snippets.
sam: fixed anchor id to "kv-cache-note" and updated headings and snippet formatting. pushed a commit.
ci-bot: preview rebuild queued for PR #4901 (triggered by sam). status: running.
ci-bot: preview build succeeded for PR #4901 1: website preview: https://deploy-preview-4901.redwood.ai
docs-bot: docs-lint: terminology check shows remaining issue: add a short migration note about KV cache invalidation when upgrading model revisions.
ashley: add that migration note (one sentence) and assign reviewers: @devon (voice), @mica (terminology), @linus (link/preview). target merge ~3:05pm after approvals.
devon: reviewed, left two tiny inline phrasing suggestions.
mica: terminology pass done. changed "KV key" -> "cache key" in two spots. approved. :white_check_mark:
linus: link/preview look good. approved.
ashley: all approvals in. merging after freeze window lifts. thanks everyone. :pray:
ashley: merged PR #4901 at 1965010500 1: closing thread.
